<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    s=set()
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        s.add((n['color'],min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return s
blocks=[(56,12),(56,16),(56,24),(56,28),(56,34),(56,38),(56,46),(56,50)]
prev=snap(current_frame)
for (r,c) in blocks:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    cur=snap(current_frame)
    rem=[x for x in prev-cur]; add=[x for x in cur-prev]
    print(f"click {r},{c}:")
    print("  -",sorted(rem))
    print("  +",sorted(add))
    prev=cur
print("score",last_action_result.get('score'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(f):
    s=set()
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        s.add((n['color'],min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return s
blocks=[(56,12),(56,16),(56,24),(56,28),(56,34),(56,38),(56,46),(56,50)]

for (r,c) in blocks:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    cur=snap(current_frame)
    rem=[x for x in prev-cur]; add=[x for x in cur-prev]
    print(f"click {r},{c}:")
    print("  -",sorted(rem))
    print("  +",sorted(add))
    prev=cur
print("score",last_action_result.get('score'))
